# Growth vs Value Equities Update

Report 118 | Published 2023-09-03 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2023-9-3/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/118.json)

Liquidity, BRICS and equity valuation.

The Egypt devaluation horizon was a clear success, and the Grayscale procedural interpretation was careful. The BRICS entry headline overstated completed membership, although the Argentina caveat was explicit. Visa and HDFC have sharply divergent interim outcomes under the same unfinished five-year horizon. Uranium’s near-term follow-through was strong; oil and growth-versus-value narratives require separation of commodity prices, equity returns and causal explanations. Neutral exits are not bearish predictions.

**Coverage:** Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.

## Analytical tools and charts

- **Liquidity/M2:** Funding and money proxies. Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Labor/PMI:** Cyclical momentum. Visual inspection: not performed.
- **FAST Graphs:** Valuation comparisons. Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Momentum:** Price trend context. Visual inspection: not performed.

## Framework lessons

- Separate a valuation screen from a timed forecast.

## Verification limitations

- Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
- Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
- Chart pixels were not inspected; numerical checks use independently downloaded data.
- Declared return windows are evaluator sensitivities unless the author supplied the five-year horizon.
